newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four French opinion polls due on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Four French opinion polls due on Saturday.

text.p: Four opinion polls of voter intentions were due to released on Saturday, the last day polls can be published ahead of a May 25/June 1 election, polling organisation officials said on Friday.
A Louis Harris poll for LCI television will probably be released first. A Harris source said the time of publication had to be determined, but it could be in the morning.

A BVA poll for Europe 1 radio, France 2 television and weekly Paris Match will be released at 1600 GMT. A Sofres poll for TF1 television will be released at 1800 GMT, sources at the respective polling organistions said.
French Sunday newspaper Journal du Dimanche said it would be publishing an IFOP poll, which would be released first by BFM radio at 1800 GMT on Saturday.
Under French law it is forbidden for opinion polls to be published in France the week before a parliamentary election or in the week between the two rounds of voting.
A CSA opinion poll, however, is due to appear in Swiss newspaper Tribune de Geneve's from 1700 GMT on May 22, an official at polling organisation CSA said.
The internet address for Tribune de Geneve is www.edicom.ch/tdg/.
